summary: The York Water Company filed an 8-K announcing the closing of the underwriters' full exercise of their option to purchase 228,261 additional shares, completing a public offering of 1,521,739 shares at $28.50 per share. This is an ordinary equity shelf takedown, not a special situation. No premium, board recommendation, advisors, or structural complexities beyond standard underwriting are noted. There are no deal terms because this is a routine capital markets transaction with no merger, tender, or restructuring event.
